name: Multi-agent review: sidebar entry, configure screen and PR-page picker
description: Reachability of the multi-agent review UI without starting a run (the e2e stack has no deterministic LLM, so 'Run multi-agent review' is never clicked). From the PR list, open the sidebar 'Multi-Agent Review' entry and confirm the Configure screen shows its empty state ('Pick a pull request first'). Then go back to Pull Requests, open PR #482 and open the Run Review picker ('Pick agents to run'). Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo.
